Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. We’ve attached a first-pass SOW (PI_OEM_SOW_v1.pdf) and a short integration ask list. Portal Integrator is excited to embed Redwood’s runtime into our Portal product and surface the white-label assistant as a co-branded feature for our reseller channel.

High-level asks from our side:
- single-tenant branding control per reseller
- minor UI theming (logo, primary/secondary colors, placeholder text)
- telemetry hooks (usage events, error codes) forwarded to our analytics pipeline
- clear SLA for token latency and error budgets for production traffic
- support for our SSO (SAML) flow and an initial list of API rate limits

Can we get a kickoff next week? Prefer morning PT. I copied Tom (product) and Legal will chime on SOW edits separately.

Best,

Kate — thanks and excited to get started. Attachments received. I’ve sketched a concise kickoff agenda below and attached an integration matrix that our engineering team can use to triage items. Proposed agenda (30 mins):

1) Success criteria & first 90 days (reseller pilot targets, telemetry signals)
2) Technical scope: SSO, branding surface area, API & model aliasing, quotas
3) Ops & support: incident escalation path, runbooks, error budget
4) Commercial check: revenue share, trial pricing, SOW redlines
5) Next steps & owners + tentative dates

Immediate clarifications that will help us prepare:
- Is the preference for a single-tenant runtime per reseller or a multi-tenant config with namespacing?
- Will Portal Integrator host the customer-facing UI and call Redwood via your cloud, or do you prefer Redwood-managed runtime behind your VPC?
- Any specific telemetry fields you need beyond event, user_id (anonymized), error_code, and latency_ms?

We can do 60 minutes if the team wants deeper tech time — Monday 10/4 or Wednesday 10/6 mornings PT both work for us. I’ve attached integration_api_matrix.xlsx with initial column headers for endpoints, auth, rate limits, and telemetry.

Attachments: integration_api_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

-jasmine

Kate / Tom — quick engineering points to help scope the integration:

- Model aliasing: We can expose a partner-scoped model alias (e.g., portal-prod-v1) that pins a model + quantization profile. That gives you predictable latency without managing models.
- API surface: standard endpoints for /generate, /chat, /embeddings; we’ll add an optional /telemetry hook where we POST event batches to a Portal-managed endpoint, or you can pull from a secure kinesis stream.
- Auth: support for API key (redwood-managed) + optional mTLS for high-assurance resellers. For SSO of your customers, we recommend redirecting to your identity flow and exchanging a short-lived session token to Redwood for calls.
- Namespacing: single-tenant runtime per high-volume reseller is possible but requires dedicated capacity reservation (cost + SLA). Multi-tenant namespacing works for lower tiers and is cheaper.
- Client-side theming: we’ll keep the theming surface limited to CSS vars and a small branding payload. No customer-facing model prompting is allowed in the branding layer (we’ll provide examples).
- Rate limits & batching: suggest initial soft-rate limit of 60 req/s per reseller with autoscaling for burst. We’ll provide batch sizing guidance to control per-token cost.

Action items for kickoff:
1) Portal to confirm preferred tenancy model (single-tenant vs namespaced)
2) Portal to provide SAML metadata if you want Redwood to accept enterprise SSO assertions
3) Redwood to send a templated runbook and incident escalation contact

Attachments: redwood_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf)

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is helpful. Confirming: Monday 10/04 at 10:00 AM PT for a 60 min kickoff (calendar invite to follow). A couple of follow-ups from our side before the call:

- We prefer a multi-tenant namespaced approach for the pilot. If the pilot hits the thresholds we’ll evaluate per-reseller dedicated capacity.
- Legal will propose two small SOW redlines (one on liability cap and one on data retention window). Expect comments in the Drive doc by EOD Friday.
- For telemetry we want payloads for event_type, anonymized_user_id, product_area, latency_ms, model_alias, and error_category. We’ll paste a sample payload to the Drive folder.
- On revenue share: high-level ask is 70/30 in favor of Portal during the first 12 months for signed resellers. Let’s table exact % for the kickoff and have finance join in subsequent calls.

We’ll upload SAML metadata in the Drive folder and add our product engineer (Tom) to the invite. Also will sign the mutual NDA addendum before we exchange any PII.

DocuSign link for initial SOW will be posted once Legal reviews: https://www.docusign.com/PI-SOW-2026

Looking forward to the kickoff — attaching a short tech contact list and our reseller pilot goals.
